items.name: AhoCorasickKind
items.summary: The type of Aho-Corasick implementation to use in an [`AhoCorasick`] searcher.

items.name: AhoCorasick
items.summary: An automaton for searching multiple strings in linear time.

methods.name: builder
methods.signature: fn builder() -> AhoCorasickBuilder
methods.summary: A convenience method for returning a new Aho-Corasick builder.

methods.name: find
methods.signature: fn find<'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&self, input: I) -> Option<Match>
methods.summary: Returns the location of the first match according to the match semantics that this automaton was constructed with.

methods.name: find_iter
methods.signature: fn find_iter<'a, 'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&'a self, input: I) -> FindIter<'a, 'h>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of non-overlapping matches, using the match semantics that this automaton was constructed with.

methods.name: find_overlapping
methods.signature: fn find_overlapping<'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&self, input: I, state: &mut OverlappingState)
methods.summary: Returns the location of the first overlapping match in the given input with respect to the current state of the underlying searcher.

methods.name: find_overlapping_iter
methods.signature: fn find_overlapping_iter<'a, 'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&'a self, input: I) -> FindOverlappingIter<'a, 'h>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of overlapping matches. Stated differently, this returns an iterator of all possible matches at every position.

methods.name: is_match
methods.signature: fn is_match<'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&self, input: I) -> bool
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this automaton matches the haystack at any position.

methods.name: kind
methods.signature: fn kind(&self) -> AhoCorasickKind
methods.summary: Returns the kind of the Aho-Corasick automaton used by this searcher.

methods.name: match_kind
methods.signature: fn match_kind(&self) -> MatchKind
methods.summary: Returns the match kind used by this automaton.

methods.name: max_pattern_len
methods.signature: fn max_pattern_len(&self) -> usize
methods.summary: Returns the length of the longest pattern matched by this automaton.

methods.name: memory_usage
methods.signature: fn memory_usage(&self) -> usize
methods.summary: Returns the approximate total amount of heap used by this automaton, in units of bytes.

methods.name: min_pattern_len
methods.signature: fn min_pattern_len(&self) -> usize
methods.summary: Returns the length of the shortest pattern matched by this automaton.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new<I, P>(patterns: I) -> Result<AhoCorasick, BuildError> where I: IntoIterator<Item = P>, P: AsRef<[u8]>
methods.summary: Create a new Aho-Corasick automaton using the default configuration.

methods.name: patterns_len
methods.signature: fn patterns_len(&self) -> usize
methods.summary: Return the total number of patterns matched by this automaton.

methods.name: replace_all
methods.signature: fn replace_all<B>(&self, haystack: &str, replace_with: &[B]) -> String where B: AsRef<str>
methods.summary: Replace all matches with a corresponding value in the `replace_with` slice given. Matches correspond to the same matches as reported by [`AhoCorasick::find_iter`].

methods.name: replace_all_bytes
methods.signature: fn replace_all_bytes<B>(&self, haystack: &[u8], replace_with: &[B]) -> Vec<u8> where B: AsRef<[u8]>
methods.summary: Replace all matches using raw bytes with a corresponding value in the `replace_with` slice given. Matches correspond to the same matches as reported by [`AhoCorasick::find_iter`].

methods.name: replace_all_with
methods.signature: fn replace_all_with<F>(&self, haystack: &str, dst: &mut String, replace_with: F) where F: FnMut(&Match, &str, &mut String) -> bool
methods.summary: Replace all matches using a closure called on each match. Matches correspond to the same matches as reported by [`AhoCorasick::find_iter`].

methods.name: replace_all_with_bytes
methods.signature: fn replace_all_with_bytes<F>(&self, haystack: &[u8], dst: &mut Vec<u8>, replace_with: F) where F: FnMut(&Match, &[u8], &mut Vec<u8>) -> bool
methods.summary: Replace all matches using raw bytes with a closure called on each match. Matches correspond to the same matches as reported by [`AhoCorasick::find_iter`].

methods.name: start_kind
methods.signature: fn start_kind(&self) -> StartKind
methods.summary: Returns the type of starting search configuration supported by this Aho-Corasick automaton.

methods.name: stream_find_iter
methods.signature: fn stream_find_iter<'a, R: std::io::Read>(&'a self, rdr: R) -> StreamFindIter<'a, R>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of non-overlapping matches in the given stream. Matches correspond to the same matches as reported by [`AhoCorasick::find_iter`].

methods.name: try_find
methods.signature: fn try_find<'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&self, input: I) -> Result<Option<Match>, MatchError>
methods.summary: Returns the location of the first match according to the match semantics that this automaton was constructed with, and according to the given `Input` configuration.

methods.name: try_find_iter
methods.signature: fn try_find_iter<'a, 'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&'a self, input: I) -> Result<FindIter<'a, 'h>, MatchError>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of non-overlapping matches, using the match semantics that this automaton was constructed with.

methods.name: try_find_overlapping
methods.signature: fn try_find_overlapping<'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&self, input: I, state: &mut OverlappingState) -> Result<(), MatchError>
methods.summary: Returns the location of the first overlapping match in the given input with respect to the current state of the underlying searcher.

methods.name: try_find_overlapping_iter
methods.signature: fn try_find_overlapping_iter<'a, 'h, I: Into<Input<'h>>>(&'a self, input: I) -> Result<FindOverlappingIter<'a, 'h>, MatchError>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of overlapping matches.

methods.name: try_replace_all
methods.signature: fn try_replace_all<B>(&self, haystack: &str, replace_with: &[B]) -> Result<String, MatchError> where B: AsRef<str>
methods.summary: Replace all matches with a corresponding value in the `replace_with` slice given. Matches correspond to the same matches as reported by [`AhoCorasick::try_find_iter`].

methods.name: try_replace_all_bytes
methods.signature: fn try_replace_all_bytes<B>(&self, haystack: &[u8], replace_with: &[B]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, MatchError> where B: AsRef<[u8]>
methods.summary: Replace all matches using raw bytes with a corresponding value in the `replace_with` slice given. Matches correspond to the same matches as reported by [`AhoCorasick::try_find_iter`].

methods.name: try_replace_all_with
methods.signature: fn try_replace_all_with<F>(&self, haystack: &str, dst: &mut String, replace_with: F) -> Result<(), MatchError> where F: FnMut(&Match, &str, &mut String) -> bool
methods.summary: Replace all matches using a closure called on each match. Matches correspond to the same matches as reported by [`AhoCorasick::try_find_iter`].

methods.name: try_replace_all_with_bytes
methods.signature: fn try_replace_all_with_bytes<F>(&self, haystack: &[u8], dst: &mut Vec<u8>, replace_with: F) -> Result<(), MatchError> where F: FnMut(&Match, &[u8], &mut Vec<u8>) -> bool
methods.summary: Replace all matches using raw bytes with a closure called on each match. Matches correspond to the same matches as reported by [`AhoCorasick::try_find_iter`].

methods.name: try_stream_find_iter
methods.signature: fn try_stream_find_iter<'a, R: std::io::Read>(&'a self, rdr: R) -> Result<StreamFindIter<'a, R>, MatchError>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of non-overlapping matches in the given stream. Matches correspond to the same matches as reported by [`AhoCorasick::try_find_iter`].

methods.name: try_stream_replace_all
methods.signature: fn try_stream_replace_all<R, W, B>(&self, rdr: R, wtr: W, replace_with: &[B]) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> where R: std::io::Read, W: std::io::Write, B: AsRef<[u8]>
methods.summary: Search for and replace all matches of this automaton in the given reader, and write the replacements to the given writer. Matches correspond to the same matches as reported by [`AhoCorasick::try_find_iter`].

methods.name: try_stream_replace_all_with
methods.signature: fn try_stream_replace_all_with<R, W, F>(&self, rdr: R, wtr: W, replace_with: F) -> Result<(), std::io::Error> where R: std::io::Read, W: std::io::Write, F: FnMut(&Match, &[u8], &mut W) -> Result<(), std::io::Error>
methods.summary: Search the given reader and replace all matches of this automaton using the given closure. The result is written to the given writer. Matches correspond to the same matches as reported by [`AhoCorasick::try_find_iter`].

items.name: AhoCorasickBuilder
items.summary: A builder for configuring an Aho-Corasick automaton.

methods.name: ascii_case_insensitive
methods.signature: fn ascii_case_insensitive(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut AhoCorasickBuilder
methods.summary: Enable ASCII-aware case insensitive matching.

methods.name: build
methods.signature: fn build<I, P>(&self, patterns: I) -> Result<AhoCorasick, BuildError> where I: IntoIterator<Item = P>, P: AsRef<[u8]>
methods.summary: Build an Aho-Corasick automaton using the configuration set on this builder.

methods.name: byte_classes
methods.signature: fn byte_classes(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut AhoCorasickBuilder
methods.summary: A debug settting for whether to attempt to shrink the size of the automaton's alphabet or not.

methods.name: dense_depth
methods.signature: fn dense_depth(&mut self, depth: usize) -> &mut AhoCorasickBuilder
methods.summary: Set the limit on how many states use a dense representation for their transitions. Other states will generally use a sparse representation.

methods.name: kind
methods.signature: fn kind(&mut self, kind: Option<AhoCorasickKind>) -> &mut AhoCorasickBuilder
methods.summary: Choose the type of underlying automaton to use.

methods.name: match_kind
methods.signature: fn match_kind(&mut self, kind: MatchKind) -> &mut AhoCorasickBuilder
methods.summary: Set the desired match semantics.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new() -> AhoCorasickBuilder
methods.summary: Create a new builder for configuring an Aho-Corasick automaton.

methods.name: prefilter
methods.signature: fn prefilter(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut AhoCorasickBuilder
methods.summary: Enable heuristic prefilter optimizations.

methods.name: start_kind
methods.signature: fn start_kind(&mut self, kind: StartKind) -> &mut AhoCorasickBuilder
methods.summary: Sets the starting state configuration for the automaton.
